title: Reconcile operator-price provenance before using any market comparison
problem: The engine holds 78 close-labelled FanDuel rows while the market desk has 0/78 operator open/close rows populated. Hashes reproduce the committed text files, but no operator page was fetched here and no opening quotes exist in the engine register.

options.label: A — Establish permitted first-party capture
options.text: The owners document source, rights, jurisdiction, capture method, raw page bytes, timestamp and the exact open/close convention for each quote.

options.label: B — Use a licensed feed
options.text: Replace the unverified capture claim with a licensed feed and durable, timestamped opening/closing snapshots.

options.label: C — Fail closed (recommended now)
options.text: Keep market line, residual, CLV and realized ROI blank/blocked until A or B is supported.

recommendation: C now; test A/B within the owners' scopes. Do not silently delete or relabel the existing rows.
decision: Not made by this review; both price owners need to reconcile the records.
would_change_our_mind_up: Every required market has an independently auditable permitted open and close with source, time, region, raw evidence and settlement terms; both stores agree.
would_change_our_mind_down: A source/terms audit shows the recorded values cannot be reproduced or retained; keep them out of any price-dependent claim.
status: AWAITING OWNER REVIEW — no changes implemented

title: Make the roster readiness claim match the roster register
problem: R-13 says 32/32 roster captures, while its cited sweep contains one populated roster count/URL and 31 blank rows.

options.label: A — Complete the sweep
options.text: Capture all 32 official roster/reserve records with row-level URL, UTC time, counts and explicit non-capture reasons.

options.label: B — Narrow the claim (recommended if data are not available)
options.text: Keep the 32 club index, but mark the 31 uncaptured roster inputs unknown and leave roster-derived availability fields blank.

recommendation: Do not trust the 32/32 statement until it reconciles mechanically to populated source rows.
decision: Market-desk owner decision; not applied here.
would_change_our_mind_up: A row-count test proves 32/32 have valid official source URLs, capture times and a nonblank, scoped capture result.
would_change_our_mind_down: A source is unavailable or image-only; preserve the gap as unknown rather than infer a roster/depth value.

title: Keep actual lineup features behind per-game official evidence
problem: Game Book URLs exist for a Week 10 slate, but the inspected parsed starters/inactives cover one game. A separate nflverse 2026 snap-count aggregate is third-party and covers regular-season weeks 1–9 only; the market desk's 0-row statement is scoped to that separate namespace.

options.label: A — Parse official Game Books
options.text: For each modeled game, record actual starter and game-day status from the official PDF, with source URL and read time; add official snap counts only when sourced.

options.label: B — Keep personnel features disabled
options.text: If full official coverage is not available or permitted, keep starter/replacement/depth effects blank and block the feature.

recommendation: B until A is complete. Use published depth order only as a labeled source, never infer from jersey number, experience or salary.
would_change_our_mind_up: Game-level coverage and source checks pass for every fixture in the modeled window; actual status and snap inputs are kept distinct from depth-chart rank.
would_change_our_mind_down: Any game lacks an official usable record or source rights; leave that game's value blank and exclude the dependent feature.

title: Normalize standings, results and correlations to a single dated snapshot
problem: Results counts and official-input correlation values vary among desks that read the NFL standings/schedule at different times.

options.label: A — Maintain dated immutable snapshots (recommended)
options.text: Keep each read immutable; publish its capture time, hash, exact rows and linked formula inputs, then compare only aligned snapshots.

options.label: B — Refresh one canonical snapshot
options.text: Choose a source-owning desk and refresh its dated snapshot, then regenerate derived correlations and comparisons from that copy.

recommendation: Do not call date-skewed values a data defect until recomputed from the same input snapshot and definitions.
decision: No shared snapshot selected by this review.
would_change_our_mind_up: All 32 teams and relevant final games reconcile on one timestamped snapshot with identical formulas and n definitions.
would_change_our_mind_down: The captured source cannot be recovered for a past window; keep the historical rows distinct and mark the comparison unknown.
status: AWAITING OWNER REVIEW — no changes implemented

title: Preserve paper-only status until each registered strategy clears every gate
problem: The inspected command and market leaderboards show zero certified strategies; price provenance, sample/uncertainty and owner/terms questions remain open.

options.label: A — Continue paper/shadow evaluation (recommended)
options.text: Keep prospective forecasts, signal scores and notional staking separated; block promotion until every pre-registered gate passes.

options.label: B — Revisit only after evidence is complete
options.text: Require sourced market opens/closes, results, proper-score improvement with uncertainty/multiplicity control, minimum n, demotion rules, and any legal/owner decisions before certification.

recommendation: A. Do not infer certification from hit rate, displayed ROI, a high rank or a passing internal data verifier.
